answer: Homogeneous origin-cluster clustering. Agents log the entry inlet of each action; after the fact, we group identities by near-identical inlet timing and resource fingerprints. Any thread of linked identities acting together is flagged when its cluster exceeds chance overlap. Enforced rule: flagged clusters lose jade-weighted reputation accrual, so each fake identity costs a fabricated history plus forfeited earned reputation—not just a fee.
